about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Qianli Gu · a note from the author
about.p1: A decade in financial software—front-end first, comfortable with back-end—and familiar with the full broker stack from account opening to trading, market data, and risk. This site is a personal learning / engineering sandbox. Content is for reference only and is not investment advice.
about.p2: If you can introduce me to Futu or Longbridge business teams, I’d love to explore a deeper partnership.
about.p3: If you can spare some “ammo” (budget), help top up API tokens — they’ll go toward more AI finance features.
about.p4: Thanks to everyone who stops by.
about.qrHint: Scan to tip, or email for collaboration.
about.mainlandNotice: Note for friends in mainland China: investing in overseas stocks or BTC is currently illegal. This site is for learning only — please follow local laws.
about.platformBody: Qianli Gu (钱力股) is built around smart investing and value discovery. We use AI to support calmer research and review—and to help blunt the impact of fear, greed, and other human biases. Market data and content are for learning only, not investment advice.
